relation_to_main_task: 不改 Task1 的 192/192、不放宽形状限制；只问 R61 的预测子是不是因果把手：在物件止边强制换一个发射字节，答案内容是否随之翻转。

definition.gate: R62 frozen-criterion dev intervention: is the object-edge emitted byte a causal handle on content failure

held_constant.stems: the same 14 stems R61 dealt (12 new + 2 replication), same sha256 deal, no re-deal
held_constant.template: 2-hop 把{object}放到{place}; records written as {desc}是{name}。 and {desc}对应{name}。

intervention.scope: exactly one emitted byte at that position; every other position decodes freely
intervention.mechanism: override the post-mask emitted byte before advance_custom, so the state carries the forced byte

arms.none: no override; also the anchor arm
arms.sham: override with the byte the none arm already emitted at that position
arms.force_e6: override with 230 (0xE6, first byte of 放)
arms.force_e7: override with 231 (0xE7, first byte of 玉/箔/甾 class inserts)

intervention.decodes: 48 new cells x 4 arms + 8 replication cells x none = 200
intervention.not_applicable: a cell whose none arm never emitted a byte at that position has no sham/force denominator and is disclosed, not dropped silently

anchor.on_mismatch: engineering_failure; no intervention result is interpreted

machinery_guards.sham_identity: sham raw bytes and both kept edge traces must equal the none arm bitwise on every applicable new cell
machinery_guards.force_applied: every force arm must record the override at the position and the answer byte there must equal the forced value
machinery_guards.no_op_consistency: where the forced byte equals the natural byte, that force arm must equal the sham arm bitwise

denominators.rescue_candidates: new cells whose none arm is not byte exact, whose natural emitted byte exists and is not 0xE6
denominators.break_candidates: new cells whose none arm is byte exact, whose natural emitted byte exists and is not 0xE7
denominators.rescued: rescue candidates whose force_e6 arm is byte exact
denominators.broken: break candidates whose force_e7 arm is not byte exact
denominators.rates: rescued / rescue candidates, broken / break candidates

branches_in_order: sham identity or force-applied or no-op consistency violated -> engineering_failure
cpu or wall over cap -> budget_stop
either candidate count is zero -> intervention_unmeasurable
classifier.note: branches are mutually exclusive and evaluated in this order; every intervened cell is reported

main_task_rule.causal_both_directions: the emitted byte at the object edge is a causal handle on content failure in both directions; still not a capability claim and still no relaxation of the 192/192 shape limit
main_task_rule.causal_one_direction: causal in the named direction only; the other direction stays a companion readout
main_task_rule.partial_causal_effect: counts are reported per cell; no mechanism sentence beyond the counts
main_task_rule.no_causal_effect: R61's predictor is a companion readout, not a causal handle; R61 limit (c) stands

gates.structural_pass: 12 structural cells exact AND every none-arm cell field_lengths_ok
gates.anchor_match: all 56 none-arm cells equal R61 on every declared field
gates.sham_identity: all applicable sham cells bitwise equal none
gates.force_applied: all applicable force arms reached the answer
gates.no_op_consistency: force arms whose byte equals the natural byte equal sham bitwise

definition.scope: dev/synthetic only; the sealed confirm split and its holdout report are not read; no change to 192/192; conclusions limited to these stems, place 6 B and this description pair
definition.estimate_rule: D-64: single run x 3 (one run plus two replay margins) + report assembly

unit_price_source.caveat: D-69/D-71 logged unattributed unit-price drift across rounds; the cap, not the estimate, binds

definition.reimplementation_disclosure: the decode loop is rebuilt from r58 primitives because the frozen runners expose no hook; the 56-cell bitwise anchor is the precondition for interpreting any intervention

outcome.note: 锚点不命中或机器守卫被违反即 engineering_failure，干预结果不解释；即使因果成立也只是机制读数，不放宽 192/192 的形状限制。

implementation_choices: The decode loop is rebuilt from r58 primitives (observe_goal/force_payload/forced_step/edge_report/decode_endpoint/advance_custom) because the frozen runners expose no intervention hook; the 56-cell anchor is the precondition.
The override replaces the post-mask emitted byte before advance_custom, so the recurrent state carries the forced byte; only one position is touched.
The sham arm forces the byte the none arm already emitted, which makes it a bitwise identity test of the override machinery rather than a second treatment.
Force arms whose byte equals the natural byte must equal sham bitwise; this catches a non-deterministic or position-leaking override.
Rescue and break denominators exclude cells whose natural byte already equals the forced value, and those exclusions are listed rather than hidden.
raw_hex is kept for every cell so any downstream comparison can be done on bytes instead of decoded text.
